shared_elements: concentric circle or dot-in-circle motif (used as eye or independent disc)
schematic outlined figures with no interior modelling
dense all-over covering of the surface with repeated motifs
justification: Both surfaces are densely covered with schematic, purely outlined curvilinear forms, and both include sinuous serpent-like bodies together with concentric-circle/dot-in-circle discs used as eyes or free-standing motifs. However, A's repertoire is dominated by spirals, concentric-circle groups and frontal face/mask-like anthropomorphs scattered over separate boulders, whereas B shows a tightly repeated set of parallel zigzag, spine-toothed creatures converging on a single profile head, a specific compositional scheme absent from A.
